verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform with its own AI features, including an AI Editor and AI evidence gap analysis, so a buyer could fairly ask about a training opt-out. However, the evidence pack has no documented control, policy, or setting that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Its AI Systems governance module (Shadow AI discovery, AI risk scoring, AI vendor due diligence) helps customers govern their own AI tools; it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
